summary: Retest of the iteration_38 fixes. All 4 fixes are verified. Backend: the new test file passed 20/20 and the iter-38 regression file passed 51/51. FIX 1: a phone edit keeps the users.phone format (a bare number stays bare 10 digits; a +91 number stays +91) and phone_key is the 10 digits. FIX 2: name and admin-name edits work for dental/vet/blood bank/wellness_event (org and admin columns) and for nutritionist/wellness/ambulance_driver (full_name). In the UI the pencil appears on all 7 new tabs, the person dialog hides 'Provider name', and a save from the UI persisted. FIX 3: the /kyc API returns kyc_enabled=true with a 5-item checklist, the profile and all_required_approved=false. The UI shows the profile and the checklist, with no 'no profile table', 'staff account', 'Already approved' or 'now live' text, and no /labs/<uid>/staff call. FIX 4: suspend/unsuspend on dental and ambulance_driver flips the profile status to suspended and back to pending; archive/restore on blood bank sets deactivated, lists it in deleted?app=provider, then returns to pending; users.is_suspended and is_archived stay false. Regression: the MedPlus and Gomti Health checkboxes are present, the Doctor tab has 5 non-test doctors, there are 10 patients, and all 21 onboarding types create rows. The cleanup script deleted 29 test users and MedPlus is back to 'Ms. Anita Singh'/verified.

minor.issue: admin_name updates only the profile column (owner_name etc.); users.name stays as before, so the KYC page header/Account section still shows the old name (e.g. 'TEST DentOwner39' while owner_name='TEST Adm dental'). Cosmetic; the Provider App likely reads the profile column.
